name: roi-calculator
description: Interactive savings calculator (the legacy /roi-calculator/): accordion groups of number fields and 0-100% sliders, each group closing on a subtotal, beside a sticky Your Savings panel with three breakdown rows, a gradient yearly total, the daily cost of delay and a button. Port of live's `.bs-section--roi-calculator`; behaviour.js recomputes on input with live's formulas operation for operation (loss = assets x value x lost% x tracked%; ghost value = assets x value x tracked% x ghost% x remaining%; ghost cost = ghost value x (federal + state + property tax)% + .01 x ghost value x insurance; search = tracked% x days x hours_per_day x salary / work_hours_per_year; total = loss + ghost cost + search; daily = total / days_per_year), and formats every figure the way live does (two decimals, dropped when .00). Lays out by its own width (container queries), so it fits an 800px article column or a full-width band.

groups.description: The accordion sections, in order; fields name them by number (1 = first). Each: title, state (static = always open, no toggle — live's Start Your Calculation | open | closed; default closed).

fields.description: Rows in display order. Each: key, group (1-based), label, help (tooltip text on the i icon), value (the starting text; sliders 0-100), suffix (shown in the field, e.g. % or USD). Input keys: users (shown, not used by the maths — as on live), assets, asset_value, loss_pct, tracked_pct, ghost_pct, remaining_pct (the three % keys are 0-100 sliders), federal_tax, state_tax, property_tax, insurance, search_days, salary. Output keys draw a subtotal row with label: loss, ghost_value, ghost_cost, search.

results_title.description: Heading over the savings panel, e.g. Your Savings.

results.description: Breakdown rows in the savings panel. Each: key (loss | ghost_value | ghost_cost | search), label, icon (shield | money | search | chart; default per key).

total_label.description: Caption over the gradient yearly total, e.g. Yearly Savings.

daily_label.description: Caption over the daily figure (total / days_per_year), e.g. Daily Cost of Delay. Empty hides the line.

cta_label.description: Button text. Renders only with cta_url.

currency.description: Prefix on every money figure (live draws $).

hours_per_day.description: Working hours in a search day (live: 8).

work_hours_per_year.description: Paid hours a year; salary / this = hourly cost (live: 2080).

days_per_year.description: Days the yearly total is spread over for the daily cost of delay (live: 365).
